candidates.statement: Gateway checkout POST /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders returns 500 Internal Server Error; traces and logs show the 500 originating at the order service, propagating to the gateway as 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side root cause (db, redis, payment) not observed; only gateway-side evidence available.

report.explanation: Traces correlate each gateway 502 on /v1/checkout with an order-service 500 on /v1/orders; logs show http_client_request 500 to server_address order. Topology confirms gateway->order dependency. The proximate fault is order-service 500s surfacing as gateway 502s; deeper order-side cause is unobserved.
